title: Search API baseline and content-option comparison — complete 149-query scope

protocol.latency: One logical result per query and provider; end-to-end elapsed time includes a single retry after transport, HTTP, or invalid-response failure
protocol.quality: Deterministic declared-target and site-constraint checks; no model judge. Public labeled evidence evaluated separately.
protocol.review: No independent result review; machine checks only
protocol.reference: Before/after complete publisher responses verify declared target identity; volatile HTML bytes may differ. No source-body scoring.
protocol.cost: Cumulative list-price estimate over physical calls; unknown Lexmount price remains unavailable; not an invoice
protocol.execution_location: Same macOS client in Asia/Shanghai time zone; provider localization defaults; upstream geographic routing not controlled
protocol.comparison: All 149 queries, five modes in rotating serial order. Baseline: Lexmount native, DeepSeek need_content=false, Bocha summary=false. Optional-output comparisons use same-query paired differences, not historical run differences.

methods.label: Lexmount Search
methods.price_source: Product pricing not set in supplied requirements

collection_revision.root_cause: HTTP 200 can precede a truncated body; reference availability now also requires a successful transfer. Reference timeout is separate from API timing.

cohort_revision.reason: Expand from 24 to 120 preregistered queries; public query catalog and exact community queries added. New complete matrix; previous pilot retained separately.
